Freude daran, neue Technologien und Methoden praktisch zu untersuchen, Ergebnisse kritisch zu vergleichen und Erkenntnisse nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren. Nice to have: Erste Erfahrungen mit dem lokalen oder serverseitigen Betrieb von LLMs, Inferenz-Servern oder GPU-Systemen. Kenntnisse in RAG, Embeddings, Vektordatenbanken oder der Bewertung von KI-Ausgaben. Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines, beispielsweise mit GitHub Actions oder GitLab CI/CD. Kenntnisse in Monitoring, Logging, Backup-Konzepten oder Infrastructure as Code, etwa mit Ansible oder Terraform. Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, Cloud-Plattformen oder der Administration dedizierter Server. Außerdem wichtig: Du möchtest den Aufbau unseres AI Departments aktiv mitgestalten und arbeitest an KI-Infrastruktur, Backend-Anwendungen und der Erprobung neuer KI-Methoden. Du denkst pragmatisch: Du möchtest verstehen, welche Lösung für einen konkreten Anwendungsfall zuverlässig funktioniert und wie sich Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Kosten sinnvoll abwägen lassen. Du musst noch nicht alle genannten Technologien beherrschen. Eine solide technische Grundlage, Lernbereitschaft und eigene praktische Erfahrungen sind uns wichtiger als eine möglichst lange Liste an Tools. Tätigkeiten Als Backend KI-Infrastruktur Engineer bei 58agents gestaltest du den Aufbau unseres KI Bereichs mit. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung serverseitiger Anwendungen und dem Betrieb selbst gehosteter KI-Modelle. Du schaffst die technische Grundlage für interne Werkzeuge, mit denen wir Arbeitsabläufe automatisieren und vertrauliche Daten auf eigener Infrastruktur verarbeiten können. Deine Aufgaben umfassen unter anderem: Einrichtung, Betrieb und Optimierung selbst gehosteter KI-Modelle auf unserer Serverinfrastruktur Entwicklung von Backend-Anwendungen, APIs und Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Systemen Automatisierung von Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozessen Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Logging, Zugriffsschutz und sicheren Betriebskonzepten Recherche und praktische Erprobung von KI-Methoden für interne Workflows, beispielsweise RAG, Tool-Nutzung und bei Bedarf Fine-Tuning Vergleich von Modellen und Lösungsansätzen anhand von Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Kosten Überführung geeigneter Prototypen in zuverlässige, wartbare Anwendungen sowie Dokumentation der Ergebnisse Du begleitest Lösungen vom ersten Experiment bis zum täglichen Einsatz. Was sich intern bewährt, kann später auch die Grundlage für Angebote an unsere Kunden bilden. Team Du wirst Teil unseres KI Departments und gestaltest dessen Aufbau von Anfang an mit. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir KI-Werkzeuge, die unseren Arbeitsalltag erleichtern und uns unabhängiger von einzelnen Anbietern machen. Dabei verbinden wir praktische Softwareentwicklung mit der Neugier, neue Technologien auszuprobieren und ihren Nutzen kritisch zu prüfen. Was uns auszeichnet: Wir helfen uns gegenseitig, teilen unser Wissen offen und lernen gemeinsam aus Experimenten und Erfahrungen. Du bekommst Raum für eigene Ideen und kannst technische Entscheidungen und unsere Arbeitsweise aktiv mitgestalten. Wir setzen auf kurze Entscheidungswege, Eigenverantwortung und einen offenen, respektvollen Austausch. Wir gestalten unsere Zusammenarbeit flexibel - remote oder hybrid, passend zu den Aufgaben und in Abstimmung mit dem Team. Dich erwarten Workation-Möglichkeiten, 30+ Tage Urlaub und eine leistungsorientierte Vergütung. Über das Unternehmen Unsere Leidenschaft ist die Entwicklung von digitalen Produkten . Wir lieben Technik, doch für uns ist sie ein Werkzeug, ein Mittel zum Zweck, um Nutzer:innen unserer digitalen Anwendung zu begeistern und ihre Erfahrung mit unserer Arbeit zu einer einzigartigen Bereicherung zu machen. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden in jeder Projektphase, mit unserer bewährten Methodik, Vielfältigkeit und unserer langjährigen Erfahrung – weit über Kontext und Domäne hinaus. review_candidates.description: Job Description: The Elevator Pitch: Why will you enjoy this new opportunity? The Virtual Machine Monitor Group (“Monitor Group”) is responsible for the core CPU and memory virtualization technology used in all of Broadcom's VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Division products. You will have the opportunity to work with bleeding edge CPU technology, VT-x/AMD-V, interrupt virtualization, memory virtualization/management, and virtualization of other forms of compute technologies and accelerators. The VCF Division works to build products and solutions that power the hybrid cloud. Working alongside other highly motivated and capable engineers you will get to interact with our largest customers to define the next generation of Broadcom's industry-leading VMWare Cloud Foundation platform. Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes over the first 6-12 months you will work toward completing? The Monitor Group’s principal function is to maintain and develop the virtual CPU and memory aspects of the virtual machine platform that runs guest operating systems. In the first 6 months, you will be expected to get up to speed with one of the specialization areas, such as new CPU feature enablement, x86_64 instruction set (ISA) virtualization, confidential computing, modernization of the monitor architecture, hardware accelerators, power-aware compute or aspects of guest timekeeping. By year 1 you would be expected to have impactful, core engineering contributions and enhancements in your area of specialization. The Work: What type of work will you be doing? What assignments, requirements, or skills will you be performing on a regular basis? This role requires you to possess a deep understanding of processor architecture and low-level OS kernel internals, system software including memory management, resource management, and interrupt architecture. The principal programming language used is C, with assembly code used whenever needed to deal with machine-specific constructs. You will work independently and as a member of a team of software engineers to design and deliver features in support of new processors or a proposed enhancement for the virtual machine monitor architecture. As an example, you might be involved in the design and implementation of upcoming CPU instruction set updates in a virtualization context. Similarly, you may be assigned to contribute to an aspect of memory virtualization/management features as part of a monitor modernization effort. For more senior roles you would be expected to make proposals that help define the design roadmap, or drive a technical effort leading other engineers. What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team like? You will be joining as a Virtual Machine Monitor Engineer as part of the Monitor Group. The Monitor Group is a part of the VMWare Cloud Foundation (VCF) Division under Broadcom. This organization handles all aspects of virtual machine engineering and has deep roots in the history of the company. The Monitor Group is highly collaborative in nature, with a well-established culture of engineering discipline. Here you will have the opportunity not only to interact with other team members within the Group, but also other groups working on core aspects of vSphere. You will lead your part within the projects, as well as frequently be given the opportunity to present your work to others and learn about the novel work of other engineers. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field and 8+ years of related experience or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field and 6+ years of related experience or PhD plus 3+ years. Experience in C, and assembly programming Experience working on the kernel and /or virtualization space Proficient in x86_64 CPU architecture Must have legal authorization to work in the US. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law. If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence. Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements. Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. It was founded in Espoo in 2013 and is now used by many organisations worldwide, including If, L'Óreal, Cathay Pacific and Eurowings. Our customers use it to collect ideas from employees and partners, develop the best ones and turn them into measurable business results. Since 2021 we have been part of HYPE Innovation, an international group with offices in Germany, Finland, the US and Canada. You get the stability of an established product and an international group, with the influence and pace of a small team. The role and the team This is a true full-stack role, split roughly 50/50 between frontend, backend and even DevOps. You will join two developers, one based in Espoo and one in Europe, as the team's third developer. The whole team meets a few times a year and the team members in Finland meet at the office on a weekly basis. What you will do: Develop new features across the whole stack, from Django models and APIs to the user interface Work in a large, long-lived codebase and keep it healthy as it grows Help modernise the frontend and the parts around the core, step by step Influence technical decisions and ways of working, as an equal member of a small team Use AI-assisted development in your daily work, with a human in the loop What we're looking for We are looking for a senior developer who enjoys both frontend and backend work and doesn't strongly prefer one over the other. You'll succeed in this role if you have: Several years (10+ years) of professional experience in full-stack web development Strong hands-on experience with Django and Python. Those are the techs you’d be working with the most. Solid JavaScript skills and a genuine interest in frontend work Strong programming fundamentals that you rely on, even when you work with AI tools Experience working in a large, long-lived codebase The habit of solving problems independently, and of asking for help when it makes sense Good communication skills in English It's a plus if you have: Experience with Django REST Framework Experience with other frontend technologies like Vue.js for example Experience with authentication and identity: OAuth, SAML, JWT Experience with multi-tenant SaaS on AWS Finnish language skills What we offer: Real influence: in a team of three developers, your ideas shape the product and the codebase Location: anywhere in Finland. Work remotely or in hybrid mode; our office is in the Helsinki region. An established product: paying customers around the world and a stable international group behind us Modern ways of working, including AI-assisted development Contact & next steps Nawia is helping HYPE Boards in this recruitment. In case you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact: Tommi Talja – Senior IT Recruitment Consultant tommi.talja@nawia.fi 0407467385 Submit your application by 22.11.2026.
